title: Lazy Turkey Thigh Mole

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless turkey thighs, cut into 1.5-inch chunks
hot honey
ingredients.note: or regular honey plus a pinch of cayenne for mild heat

steps.title: Whisk the lazy mole sauce
steps.text: In a medium bowl or large glass measuring cup, whisk together {chicken_broth}, {tomato_sauce}, {peanut_butter}, {cocoa_powder}, {hot_honey}, {coconut_aminos}, {black_garlic_puree}, {chili_powder}, {smoked_paprika}, {ground_cumin}, {granulated_onion}, {ground_cinnamon}, and {mexican_oregano} until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Season and sear the turkey thighs
steps.text: Pat {turkey_thighs} dry and season evenly with {kosher_salt} and {black_pepper}. Heat {avocado_oil} in a 12-inch lidded HexClad skillet over medium-high heat and sear the turkey pieces for 3 to 4 minutes total, turning once or twice just to get light color on the outside.

steps.title: Simmer the turkey in the sauce
steps.text: Pour the whisked mole sauce directly over the turkey in the skillet, stirring to lift any browned bits. Bring to a gentle simmer, lower the heat to medium-low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 15 minutes until the turkey is tender and registers 175 to 180 degrees F internally.

steps.title: Thicken with slurry and finish
steps.text: In a small cup, stir {cornstarch} and {cold_water} until completely smooth. Uncover the skillet over medium heat, pour in the cornstarch slurry while stirring constantly, and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce turns glossy and thick enough to cling heavily to every piece. Garnish with {sesame_seeds} if using and serve immediately.

steps.title: Set up the cooking vessel
steps.text: Start the enamel Dutch oven over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes; use the lid for covered steps. Reduce heat once liquids simmer and stir across the heavy base.

notes: Make ahead: Whisk the sauce up to 2 days ahead and refrigerate. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze the turkey submerged in sauce for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: warm covered with a little water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the refrigerator and reheat as above. For gentler seasoning use sweet paprika in place of chili powder.
